name: Dialspin
summary: A retro rotary phone PIN: drag a hole to the stop and the wheel springs back, counting pulses
about: A mint telephone with a cherry finger wheel and a cream PIN card in the middle. Drag any hole round to the metal stop and let go: the wheel springs back while the display ticks through the pulses, just like an old phone. The right PIN makes the phone ring, the handset lifts, the card flips to Connected and music notes float out.
how: Drag a finger hole clockwise to the metal stop and let go, or tap a hole to dial it
You can also type or paste the PIN into the four tiles; backspace and the arrow keys move between them
As the wheel returns, the tile counts up the pulses and settles on your digit
The right PIN rings the bell, lifts the handset, flips the centre card and lights the tiles green
A wrong PIN flashes the tiles red and wobbles the phone; Hang up starts again
